operations.title: Exact integral Adams and physical-selection gate
operations.method: Verify basis-product ring endomorphism laws, Adams composition, Frobenius congruences, and dual coefficient delta-selection mismatches for Z[(C2)^5].

operations.title: The integral five-site Betti deck ring has canonical Adams operations but no full physical lambda promotion
operations.body: Z[(C2)^5], viewed as the representation ring of the dual group with basis characters as line elements, has canonical special lambda operations with psi^n(g)=g^n, multiplicative composition, and Frobenius congruences. On dual coefficient functions, identity selection is preserved exactly for odd n; every even n changes 31 of 32 values. Thus algebraic Adams structure exists conditionally, while common paired physical lambda structure does not.

operations.outcome: pass: 12288 ring-homomorphism checks, 4608 Adams-composition checks, 8192 Frobenius-congruence checks; odd selection mismatches 0, even mismatches 31

evidence.paraphrase: Exact integral and modular enumeration separates canonical algebraic Adams structure from physical selection compatibility.
